name: Workflow 1 - Stripe Client Payment to Receipt Email

parameters.content:
## Workflow 1: Stripe client payment -> ERP -> receipt -> email

**Before activating**
1. Run schema.sql in Postgres
2. Edit the secret in **Verify Signature** and the constants in **Config & Event**
3. Set env `NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto`
4. Assign credentials: Stripe API, Postgres, SMTP, AWS S3, Header Auth (ERP)
5. Run Gotenberg (HTML to PDF) and set its URL
6. In Stripe, point a webhook endpoint at the **production** URL of the Stripe Webhook node

**Stripe events to enable:** invoice.finalized, invoice.paid, invoice.payment_failed, charge.dispute.created, credit_note.created

Set an Error Workflow in workflow settings so failed runs alert Finance.

**Critical gate**
Signature verified on the raw body, replay window checked, event de-duplicated by event ID (zero rows returned = duplicate = run stops).

**invoice.paid path**
Re-fetch from Stripe -> validate -> post to ERP -> receipt PDF -> hash -> store -> email -> audit log. Any mismatch goes to the exception queue, never auto-posts.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO stripe_events (event_id, event_type, payload, status) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, 'received') ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING event_id;
UPDATE stripe_events SET status = 'processed', processed_at = now() WHERE event_id = $1 RETURNING event_id;

WITH x AS (INSERT INTO finance_exceptions (event_id, invoice_id, reasons) VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb) RETURNING id) UPDATE stripe_events SET status = 'exception', processed_at = now() WHERE event_id = $1 RETURNING event_id;

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Exception] Stripe payment needs review: ' + $('Validate Payment').first().json.invoice_id }}
parameters.html:
={{ '

A paid-invoice event failed validation and was not posted or receipted.

Invoice: ' + $('Validate Payment').first().json.invoice_id + '
Event: ' + $('Restore Context').first().json.event.id + '

    ' + $('Validate Payment').first().json.reasons.map(r => '
  • ' + r + '
    • ').join('') + '
' }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO audit_log (event_id, invoice_id, action, details) VALUES ($1, $2, 'receipt_sent', $3::jsonb) RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Restore Context').first().json.event.id, $('Validate Payment').first().json.invoice_id, JSON.stringify({ sha256: $('Hash PDF').first().json.sha256, s3_key: $('Hash PDF').first().json.s3_key, receipt_number: $('Build Receipt').first().json.receipt_number, sent_to: $('Validate Payment').first().json.customer_email, payment_intent_id: $('Validate Payment').first().json.payment_intent_id, charge_id: $('Validate Payment').first().json.charge_id })] }}

parameters.subject: ={{ '[Dunning] Repeated payment failure: ' + $('Build Failure Notice').first().json.invoice_id }}
parameters.html:
={{ '

Invoice ' + $('Build Failure Notice').first().json.invoice_id + ' has failed ' + $('Build Failure Notice').first().json.attempt_count + ' payment attempts. Please follow up with the client.

' }}
